# surya.recognition.v1

*Engine · recognition · package `linecaster-surya`*

linecaster engine for the recognition step: Surya OCR 2.5 on the whole page through the `surya-ocr` package
(full-page mode with its block-mode fallback), attached to a vLLM server that serves the pinned checkpoint
(`ServiceServer` starts it). Returns the page's HTML blocks as a text-only transcription, the package's result
verbatim as JSON next to it.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Class | `linecaster_surya:SuryaRecognitionEngine` |
| Source | [recognizer.py](https://github.com/storytracer/linecaster/blob/main/engines/surya/src/linecaster_surya/recognizer.py) |
| Reads | pages |
| Produces | lines, text, html |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint` | `str` | `'http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1'` | the vLLM server's .../v1 URL (on loopback), which serves the pin under the package's model name |
| `gpu_type` | `str` | `'a100-80'` | the package's VLLM_GPU_TYPE: the server flags it implies (package_flags) and the client's concurrency in block mode |
| `fullpage_regen` | `bool` | `False` | the package's SURYA_FULLPAGE_REGEN: ask a looping or unparseable full-page answer again at rising temperature before block mode (off by default) |
